program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Continue each diagonal stroke of at least two same-colored cells through empty background.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                        y, x = r, c
                        while 0 <= y + sr < h and 0 <= x + sc < w and out[y + sr][x + sc] == bg:
                            y += sr
                            x += sc
                            out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
